name: AMD Radeon 880M
memory_type: Shared system memory (LPDDR5X-8000 / DDR5-5600), 2 channels / 128-bit — iGPU has no dedicated VRAM
notes: iGPU in Ryzen AI 300 (Strix Point). Memory is a slice of host LPDDR5X, so capacity and bandwidth are laptop-specific. || Filled 2026-10-19: AMD product page lists LPDDR5X-8000 max memory speed, 2 channels, but publishes no iGPU bandwidth figure. 128 GB/s is derived (8000 MT/s x 16 B). Capacity is not applicable: 880M is an integrated GPU sharing host memory (configurable carve-out), so memory_gb is null rather than a fixed device capacity.
